messages.subject: Lunch & learn: Sequana and directors' duties — 11 Feb, 12:30
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

The Restructuring & Insolvency group is running a lunch & learn on the implications of BTI v Sequana for directors' duties in the zone of insolvency, Tuesday 11 February at 12:30 in Meeting Room 4. Sandwiches provided. 1 hour CPD. Please RSVP to me by Friday.

Donna
